Beware the Agent provocateur

Agent provocateurs have historically proven to be one of the most effective forms of population control and are a favorite tool of dictators and tyrants across the globe. Stalin used them. Hitler used them. Mao Tse-tung used them. Kim Jong-il used them and Kim Jong-un still uses them today.
